column1: # WHICH HARDWARE FEATURES A BITSTREAM ACTUALLY CONTAINS, KEYED ON ITS CONTENT.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  Twice this campaign has measured a feature while running silicon that
# does not contain it: the attention unit's Arm A, and b30_lnab_on_run.json, which dispatched
# LayerNorm to a lane on 0x5A5A0028 -- a bitstream the registry describes, in its own words, as
# the thing 0x5A5A0029 is "plus the two lanes".  A run record faithfully named its soc_magic and
# its bitstream_md5 and then exercised whatever it liked.  Nothing connected the two.
# scripts/lib/bitstream_id.sh answers "is this build one a lab has been validated against".
# This file answers the different question "what is INSIDE it", so a lab can be refused BEFORE
# it dispatches to hardware that is not there.
# KEYED ON md5, NOT ON MAGIC, DELIBERATELY.  A MAGIC names a CONFIGURATION and travels with a
# variant whose RTL moves underneath it -- MAGIC_REGISTRY.md's own closing note records
# `roccmoonlanes` gaining a third lane while still stamping 0x5A5A002A.  The md5 is the content
# of the file the lab loads and is the one thing a lab cannot assert about itself.  The MAGIC
# column here is what the PL is EXPECTED to read back for that md5, and the gate checks the
# readback against it; a disagreement is a refusal, not a warning.
# FAIL CLOSED.  An md5 with no row here has NO known feature set, and a lab that cannot
# determine the feature set must refuse rather than proceed.  Adding a row is a claim about
# silicon: make it from MAGIC_REGISTRY.md's row for that build, in the same commit as the
# registry row, and never from what a lab wishes were true.
# FEATURE VOCABULARY (add to it only with a registry row to point at):
#   rocc_engine    the decoupled RoCC engine (mbxr, custom-0) is elaborated in the PL
#   ln_lane        mbxr_ln, the LayerNorm/GroupNorm lane, reachable by custom-1 lgo
#   ln_twopass     the LN streamer replays its word range (0x5A5A002A's ten lines)
#   span_refusal   a range past the 1,024-word activation buffer is REFUSED, not wrapped
#   w_lane         revision 2b's weight half on its own clock behind a private AXI4 lane
#   mul_pipelined  the big core's pipelined multiplier (mulUnroll = 64)
#   l2_skip_clean  patch 0092, the skipped clean Release
#   wgt_int6       the engine's READ PORT expands 6-bit weight codes (mbxr_wunpack, and
#                  mbxr_tseq's phase): four MAC beats over three weight words, selected per
#                  DISPATCH by cfg rs1[48].  A guest that never sets that bit gets, beat for
#                  beat, the machine the build without it is -- so the feature is about what
#                  an int6 IMAGE may be loaded onto, not about what an int8 image gets.  An
#                  image built -DMBXR_RT_WBITS=6 on a build WITHOUT it hands packed codes to a
#                  byte-wide MAC: plausible numbers, silently wrong, and indistinguishable in
#                  any summary from an unpacker defect -- which is why it is a gated feature
#   drain_2d       mbxr_st's `st` descriptor is TWO-DIMENSIONAL (dst, row_bytes, nrows, row_stride)
#                  and the engine drains straight into out[npix][N].  An image built
#                  -DMBXR_RT_DRAIN_STRIDED=1 on a build without it falls back to the flat drain
#                  SILENTLY (mbxr_rt_pick reads the id word), which looks exactly like the
#                  control arm -- so the gate refuses it rather than let it be measured
#   pext           the MBP P-extension -- an image built -DMB_PEXT_HW=1 traps without it
#   mic rgb tacit  the PDM microphone, the RGB GPIO, TACIT
#   camera         the HM01B0 ospi capture + DMA + TLI2C on the Z1 shield
#   bwlab          a bandwidth instrument: no accelerator, no speech lab

The RTL delta is merge/mbxr_engine.v (cce8c84f -> d13170d8), mbxr_tseq.v (8596f212 -> e7ac9978) and mbxr_datapath.v (6c6aa1b8 -> c80c49d0). Post-route: 45,374 LUT (85.29 %), 26,756 FF, 141 DSP, 90.5 BRAM36, 12,981 slices (97.60 %), WNS +0.849, WHS +0.015 -- against 002E's 45,051 / 26,622 / 141 / 90.5 / 12,858 (96.68 %) / +0.719 / +0.026, so +323 LUT, +134 FF, 0 DSP, 0 BRAM, +123 slices, and it CLOSES with more slack than 002E. The critical path is entirely inside the L2 (coh_wrapper/l2/inclusive_cache_bank_sched/mshrs_4/s_release_reg -> mshrs_2/s_writeback_reg, 29 logic levels, 74 % route delay) and the unpacker is nowhere near it. THE int8 PATH IS BIT-EXACT AND CYCLE-IDENTICAL, which is what makes this one bitstream for both arms: compat/run_compat_tb.sh 119 / 1,078,701 / 96,619 / 63,999,256 unmoved, tb_mbxr on merge/ 201 / 1,435,630 / 127,080 / 79,347,241 unmoved

THE MAC ARRAY WIDENED TO NCH = 8 (64 MAC/cycle) AT FCLK0 = 40.0000 MHz (1000/25). Feature set is 0x5A5A0032's PLUS nch8; every lane precondition on that row still holds, the engine RTL being src/lanes_engine_b96nch8/ = lanes_engine_002f/ with EXACTLY TWO files changed (mbxa_unit.v, mbxr_lanes.v), mbxr_engine.v still d13170d8. THE TWO CHANGED FILES ARE THE WHOLE POINT: mbxr_lanes.v:190 instantiated mbxa_core WITHOUT passing NCH and mbxa_unit.v:202 hard-coded acc[127:0], so at NCH = 8 the engine drove a 256-bit accumulator into a 128-bit port and Vivado TRUNCATED IT, reporting [Synth 8-689] as a WARNING. Every out-of-context NCH=8 number this tree ever produced was measured on that mis-wired design. mbxa_core now takes NCH (default 4, so every other instantiation is unchanged); this build has ZERO 8-689 occurrences. Post-route at a 25.000 ns period: 49,102 LUT (92.30 %), 27,567 FF, 189 DSP, 106.5 BRAM36, 13,272 slices (99.79 %), WNS +0.208, WHS +0.031, 0 failing of 96,946 -- WITH ROCKET_POSTROUTE_PHYSOPT=1, which it NEEDS: on default directives the same netlist gave -0.662 with 2 failing endpoints. A SECOND INDEPENDENT DRAW of this logic closed at +0.045; two draws 0.163 ns apart, both closing, well inside this part's 0.585 ns spread -- but 13,272 of 13,300 slices is 28 SPARE and the margin means nothing on one build. The binding cone at 25.000 ns is u_lanes/u_attn/u_smx/u_div -> u_smx/so_mem, the softmax divider (the FIFTH distinct cone this campaign has seen); at 24.000 ns the same design bound on the L2 MSHR scheduler instead. ITS GUEST MUST BE BUILT FOR chipyard_pynqz1_micrgb_f40 (CONFIG_SYS_CLOCK_HW_CYCLES_PER_SEC=40000); load with --fclk 40. Added to the CAP=4 case in scripts 57, 58 AND 74 -- 74's list was stale at 0x5A5A0030 and is fixed in the same change. MAGIC_REGISTRY.md 0x5A5A0033. Lab B96

THE MAC ARRAY WIDENED TO NCH = 8 (64 MAC/cycle) AT FCLK0 = 40.0000 MHz (1000/25), WITH WEIGHT PLANE 7 ACTUALLY WRITTEN. Feature set is 0x5A5A0033's to the letter, nch8 included, because this build is 0x5A5A0033 with ONE LINE of RTL changed: the engine RTL is src/lanes_engine_b98nch8/ = lanes_engine_b96nch8/ with EXACTLY ONE file changed (mbxr_engine.v, now ee57840a), three files from shipping lanes_engine_002f/. THE ONE LINE IS THE WHOLE POINT: mbxr_whalf's port index was THREE BITS (wire [2:0] pport = pr[2:0] + 3'd1), so at NCH = 8 weight plane 7 addressed port 8, which does not fit, WRAPPED TO PORT 0 -- whose banks only the ACTIVATION write port drives (mbxd_spad2's p == 0 branch) -- and was SILENTLY DISCARDED. pbad = (pr >= NCH) could not fire: the plane index is legal, the PORT NUMBER overflows, and a 3-bit + 1 that wraps is legal Verilog with NO warning, not even [Synth 8-689]. ON 0x5A5A0033 THAT MEANS: with a MBXR_NCH=4 guest every dispatch hangs (B96 measured 0 of 4,125, last_rc -4), and with a -DMBXR_NCH=8 guest the dispatches COMPLETE and return n % 8 == 7 as ZERO with calls_engine > 0, calls_fallback = 0, last_rc = 0 and every scripts/74 gate green -- which is why 275c7282 is in bitstream_refused() and REFUSED_MD5 rather than merely superseded. GATED ON SIMULATION BEFORE PLACE-AND-ROUTE: rtl_study/roccmoon/run_nch8_gate.sh reported MBXR_NCH8_GATE_OK -- MBXR_TB_OK 119 cases at NCH = 8, and at NCH = 4 the shipping machine's EXACT 1,132,401 Gets / 122,186 Puts / 64,529,872 cycles, so 0x5A5A0032 is provably not regressed by the wider field (at NCH <= 4 the top bit is always 0 and wbank is bit-identical). Post-route at a 25.000 ns period: 49,098 LUT (92.29 %), 27,597 FF, 189 DSP, 106.5 BRAM36, 13,256 slices (99.67 %), WNS +0.137, WHS +0.036, 0 failing of 96,988, all user specified timing constraints met -- WITH ROCKET_POSTROUTE_PHYSOPT=1, which it NEEDS as 0x5A5A0033 and 0x5A5A0031 did. Against 0x5A5A0033 that is -4 LUT, +30 FF, -16 slices and the same DSP and BRAM: the four-bit port field costs nothing. Three draws of this logic now read +0.208, +0.045 and +0.137 -- all closing, all well inside this part's 0.585 ns spread, and 44 spare slices of 13,300 is NOT margin. Zero 8-689 (the build sets that ID to ERROR severity, so one would abort). ITS GUEST MUST BE BUILT FOR chipyard_pynqz1_micrgb_f40 (CONFIG_SYS_CLOCK_HW_CYCLES_PER_SEC=40000) AND COMPILED -DMBXR_NCH=8 -- scripts 57, 58 and 74 now select that by MAGIC in an NCH_CFLAG case beside CAP_CFLAG, and mbxr_rt.h re-checks it against the engine's own id word at init, refusing with MBXR_E_WIDTH = -6. Load with --fclk 40. Added to the CAP=4 case in scripts 57, 58 and 74. MAGIC_REGISTRY.md 0x5A5A0034. Lab B98

NCH = 8 AT FCLK0 = 40.0000 MHz WITH THE ATTENTION LANE ACTUALLY USABLE. Feature set is 0x5A5A0034's to the letter; this is that build with ONE LINE of mbxa_unit.v changed (src/lanes_engine_b98nch8b = b98nch8 with mbxa_unit.v alone, now b5d7d7b4). WHY IT EXISTS: 0x5A5A0034 computes linear_s8 and conv2d_s8 correctly at NCH=8 (4,200 of 4,200 dispatches, 8 of 8 sequences) and its ATTENTION LANE REFUSES EVERY DISPATCH -- attn_lane 0, attn_fallback 6, attn_last_rc -69, attn_aerr 4 (err[2], |acc| >= 2^24) -- so a fused-attention graph spends 83.97 % of the model in the software fallback and runs 7.71x SLOWER than NCH=4 with max_abs_err 0. The attention weight image is planar exactly as the engine's is and was laid out row 4j+c across FOUR planes in three independent copies while mbxr.c was parameterised at 23 of 23 sites; mbxa_unit.v:248 validated qs*4 >= nsc, the hardware half of the same NCH=4 contract. All four sites now take NCH, with MBXA_NCH derived from MBXR_NCH. GATED ON ALL FOUR ARMS BEFORE PLACE-AND-ROUTE: run_nch8_gate.sh MBXR_NCH8_GATE_OK exit 0 -- engine MBXR_TB_OK 119 cases at NCH=8 and the shipping machine's exact 1,132,401 Gets / 122,186 Puts / 64,529,872 cycles at NCH=4; ATTN_TB_OK 0 differ at BOTH widths (NCH=4 byte-identical at 29/938/32,748 through every step); LN+LUT MBXR_LANES_OK 93 cases at both. Post-route at 25.000 ns: 49,115 LUT (92.32 %), 27,567 FF, 189 DSP, 106.5 BRAM36, 13,295 slices (99.96 %, FIVE SPARE -- tighter than 0x5A5A0034's 44), WNS +0.102, WHS +0.034, 0 failing of 96,978, all user specified timing constraints met, WITH ROCKET_POSTROUTE_PHYSOPT=1. Four draws of this logic now read +0.208, +0.045, +0.137, +0.102. ITS GUEST MUST BE chipyard_pynqz1_micrgb_f40 COMPILED -DMBXR_NCH=8 (scripts 57/58/74 select it by MAGIC; MBXA_NCH follows). Load with --fclk 40. MAGIC_REGISTRY.md 0x5A5A0035. Lab B98

EVERY INTERFACE AT ONCE, TACIT TRADED FOR THE CAMERA (Lab B137, MAGIC_REGISTRY.md 0x5A5A0038). Config PynqZ2RocketBigLittlePextMicRgbRoccMoonAllNch8I2cBtnCamNoTacitConfig. The registry row states, in its own words, that it "Carries the nch = 8 RoCC engine, the MBP P-extension on hart 0, the PDM mic, the six RGB pins, the TLI2C at 0x1004_0000, BTN0..BTN3 on GPIO 6..9 and ospi@1008_0000 with its TileLink DMA master" -- which is exactly the six features claimed here and no more. TACIT IS GONE, so `tacit` is absent and samples/tacit_boot and samples/membench must keep to 0x5A5A0035/36/37. *** WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT CLAIMED, AND WHY THAT IS NOT THE SAME AS ABSENT. *** ln_lane, attn_lane, lut_lane, ln_twopass, drain_2d, wgt_int6, mul_pipelined and l2_skip_clean are LEFT OUT. The registry says this build is off the same md5-pinned engine snapshot src/lanes_engine_b98nch8b/ as 0x5A5A0035 and that RoccMoonEngine.sv/RoccMoonShim.sv/PipelinedMultiplier.sv are byte-identical to 0x5A5A0037's elaboration, so they are probably all present -- and `probably` is not what this file is for. Fail closed: a lab that needs one of them is refused until somebody establishes it and widens this row. The same gap exists in scripts/lib/mbxr_abi.sh, whose MBXR_ABI_2D_MAGICS list stops at 0x5A5A0035, so an image stamped strided=1 is refused here; Lab B139 builds strided=0 rather than widen a list it has not verified, and its graph never reaches the engine anyway (calls_engine 0). Row added by Lab B139 (scripts/83_rocket_sign_live.sh), the first lab with a LAB_REQUIRES to run on this build.
